sources.source_utf8:
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys
from xml.etree import ElementTree

sys.path.insert(0, "public-artifacts/czifile")

import czifile
import numpy as np


def digest(content: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest().upper()


def xml_content(element) -> tuple:
    text = element.text if element.text and element.text.strip() else None
    tail = element.tail if element.tail and element.tail.strip() else None
    return element.tag, sorted(element.attrib.items()), text, tail, tuple(xml_content(child) for child in element)


def main() -> None:
    root = Path("public-artifacts/pylibczirw")
    manifest = json.loads((root / "pylibCZIrw/tests/integration/test_data/fixture_manifest.json").read_text())
    assets = {asset["id"]: asset for asset in manifest["assets"]}
    results = []
    for input_id, reference_id in (("asset-001", "asset-013"), ("asset-014", "asset-015"), ("asset-020", "asset-018")):
        source = assets[input_id]
        reference = assets[reference_id]
        content = (root / source["path"]).read_bytes()
        expected_bytes = (root / reference["path"]).read_bytes()
        assert digest(content) == source["sha256"] and digest(expected_bytes) == reference["sha256"]
        with np.load(root / reference["path"], allow_pickle=False) as archive:
            expected = archive["arr"]
        with czifile.CziFile(root / source["path"]) as reader:
            assert len(reader.subblock_directory) == 1
            entry = reader.subblock_directory[0]
            assert int(entry.compression) == 0
            dimensions = {
                axis.rstrip(b"\0").decode("ascii"): (start, size, stored or size)
                for axis, start, size, physical, stored in struct.iter_unpack(
                    "<4siifi", content[entry.offset + 32:entry.offset + 32 + entry.dimensions_count * 20]
                )
            }
            height, width = dimensions["Y"][2], dimensions["X"][2]
            assert expected.shape[:2] == (height, width)
            components = 3 if entry.pixel_type.name.startswith("BGR") else 1
            actual = np.frombuffer(entry.read_segment_data(reader).data(raw=True), dtype=entry.pixel_type.dtype).reshape(height, width, components)
            assert actual.dtype == expected.dtype
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
            results.append({"id": f"legacy-pixels-{input_id}-{reference_id}", "input_asset_id": input_id, "reference_asset_id": reference_id, "state": "reference-verified", "method": "Uncompressed stored payload reshaped by raw X/Y sizes and native component count; no color swap, conversion, resampling or wrapper import", "dtype": str(actual.dtype), "shape_YXA": list(actual.shape), "component_order": "B,G,R" if components == 3 else "grayscale", "pixel_count": int(height * width), "component_count": int(actual.size), "expected_sha256": digest(expected.tobytes()), "actual_sha256": digest(actual.tobytes())})
    for input_id, reference_id in (("asset-001", "asset-035"), ("asset-003", "asset-036"), ("asset-005", "asset-037"), ("asset-007", "asset-038"), ("asset-009", "asset-039"), ("asset-011", "asset-040")):
        source = assets[input_id]
        reference = assets[reference_id]
        assert digest((root / source["path"]).read_bytes()) == source["sha256"]
        expected = (root / reference["path"]).read_bytes()
        assert digest(expected) == reference["sha256"]
        with czifile.CziFile(root / source["path"]) as reader:
            actual = reader.metadata().encode("utf8")
        normalized = actual.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
        matched = actual == expected or normalized == expected
        semantic_match = xml_content(ElementTree.fromstring(actual)) == xml_content(ElementTree.fromstring(expected))
        results.append({"id": f"legacy-XML-{input_id}-{reference_id}", "input_asset_id": input_id, "reference_asset_id": reference_id, "state": "reference-verified" if semantic_match else "blocked", "method": "Independent XML content comparison: ordered tags/attributes and all significant text/tails; ignore whitespace-only formatting and declaration spelling only. Exact native serialization remains regression evidence, not an independent byte oracle.", "semantic_match": semantic_match, "exact_native_text_oracle": "unverified" if not matched else "reference-verified", "exact_bytes": actual == expected, "approved_LF_only_equivalence": normalized == expected, "source_bytes": len(actual), "reference_bytes": len(expected), "source_sha256": digest(actual), "reference_sha256": digest(expected)})
    assert not any(name in sys.modules for name in ("_pylibCZIrw", "pylibCZIrw", "libczi"))
    reader_source = Path("public-artifacts/czifile.py")
    report = {"recorded_on": "2026-10-15", "python": sys.version, "czifile": czifile.__version__, "numpy": np.__version__, "reader_source_sha256": digest(reader_source.read_bytes()), "cases": results, "limits": "Verifies these current input/reference requests, not historical generation recipes, arbitrary zoom/conversion outputs, API implementation coverage or rights exceptions."}
    destination = Path(__file__).parent / "reference-checks-v2.json"
    assert not destination.exists()
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf8")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

verification_scope.writer_pixels: Three exact uncompressed native-order input/reference pairs used by integration/write/test_write.py: BGR24, BGR48 and Gray8; no wrapper/libCZI imports.
verification_scope.metadata_content: Six exact ordered XML element/attribute/significant-text content comparisons; whitespace-only indentation/declaration spelling ignored. This does not independently verify exact native XML serialization.
verification_scope.historical_recipes: Unknown remains unknown. Verification of current reference values is not proof of who originally generated them or with which reader/version.

introduction_evidence.subject: Add core structure
introduction_evidence.limits: An introduction commit identifies repository import, not original acquisition, generator, independent expected values or privacy clearance. A targeted current-checkout search found no NumPy save calls; generation remains unverified.

licensing.decision: Record the existing repository licensing declaration; no new per-file permission letter is presumed necessary.
licensing.verification_scope: Declaration observed, not independent proof of original producer, privacy clearance or third-party exceptions.

source_review.producer_clues: Collection-level ZEN/CZICmd/pylibCZIrw report and embedded application clues remain qualified, not per-file provenance.
source_review.limits: No newly identified exception is not proof that none exists. No license or historical producer/recipe is inferred from byte equality or a passing regression.

limits: No fixture/reference bytes changed, historical records overwritten, source history fabricated, blanket reference promotion, new-API certification or T01 completion.
